query: Review these two backend changes: one renames the lifecycle value `processing` to `in review`, which is displayed throughout the product; the other adds an internal query index without changing API output, labels, or behavior. The app has an approved status vocabulary in its project design source.
expected_behavior: Consults the applicable project design source for the displayed lifecycle rename despite the backend file path
Preserves or explicitly reconciles the approved visible status vocabulary
Skips the internal index change because it has no user-visible effect
Does not expand design review to unrelated backend work
